description: Combine InterPro signature coverage with the repeat-motif PSSM scan across MFF orthologs to locate the conserved and non-conserved modules of C. elegans MFF-1
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
S=requests.Session()
ACC=[('Q9GZY8','Hs MFF',342),('Q503U3','Dr MFFa',275),('Q961C9','Dm Tango11',277),
     ('P91344','Ce MFF-2',161),('Q19343','Ce MFF-1',158)]
seqs={l:''.join(S.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=30).text.split('\n')[1:]) for a,l,_ in ACC}
AAs='ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY'; idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
seed=['RVPEKLKV','QVPERIVV','LVPERIVI','HVPERIIV','EVPERIVV','EVPERIVI','NVPDRIVV']; L=8
pssm=np.zeros((L,20))
for p in range(L):
    c=np.ones(20)*0.5
    for s in seed: c[idx[s[p]]]+=1
    pssm[p]=np.log2((c/c.sum())/0.05)
def scan(s):
    return [(i+1,s[i:i+L],sum(pssm[p][idx[ch]] for p,ch in enumerate(s[i:i+L])))
            for i in range(len(s)-L+1) if all(ch in idx for ch in s[i:i+L])]
THR=10.96   # 99.99th pct of composition-shuffled null, n=175,800 (iteration 1 provenance)
hits=[]
for a,l,_ in ACC:
    for pos,mer,sc in scan(seqs[l]):
        if sc>=THR: hits.append({'protein':l,'pos':pos,'motif':mer,'bits':round(sc,2)})
H=pd.DataFrame(hits)
print('=== PSSM repeat hits above the 99.99th-percentile null threshold (10.96 bits, max 22.0) ===')
print(H.to_string(index=False) if len(H) else 'none')
best=pd.DataFrame([{'protein':l,'best_bits':round(max(x[2] for x in scan(seqs[l])),2),
                    'best_pos':max(scan(seqs[l]),key=lambda x:x[2])[0],
                    'best_motif':max(scan(seqs[l]),key=lambda x:x[2])[1]} for a,l,_ in ACC])
print('\n=== Best repeat-motif match per protein (regardless of threshold) ===')
print(best.to_string(index=False))
H.to_csv('mff_repeat_hits_final.csv',index=False); best.to_csv('mff_repeat_best_final.csv',index=False)

SIG={'Hs MFF':[('panther',21,342),('pfam',27,342)],'Dr MFFa':[('panther',1,275),('pfam',1,275)],
     'Dm Tango11':[('panther',9,276),('pfam',15,166),('pfam',181,276)],
     'Ce MFF-2':[('panther',1,161),('pfam',87,152)],'Ce MFF-1':[('panther',92,158)]}
order=[l for _,l,_ in ACC]; cols={'panther':'#2c7fb8','pfam':'#d95f0e'}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.6))
for i,l in enumerate(order):
    Ln=dict((x[1],x[2]) for x in ACC)[l]
    ax.plot([1,Ln],[i,i],color='0.85',lw=16,solid_capstyle='butt',zorder=1)
    for db,s,e in SIG[l]:
        y=i+(0.17 if db=='pfam' else -0.17)
        ax.plot([s,e],[y,y],color=cols[db],lw=6,solid_capstyle='butt',zorder=3)
    for _,r in H[H.protein==l].iterrows():
        ax.plot([r.pos,r.pos+7],[i,i],color='black',lw=16,solid_capstyle='butt',zorder=4)
        ax.text(r.pos+3.5,i+0.42,f'{r.bits:.1f}',ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_yticklabels(order); ax.set_xlabel('residue')
ax.set_xlim(-15,365); ax.set_ylim(-0.75,len(order)-0.3)
ax.set_title('MFF family signature coverage and repeat-motif hits')
ax.annotate('MFF-1 residues 1-91 are matched by no MFF family model\nand contain no repeat hit above threshold',
            xy=(45,len(order)-1.05), xytext=(105,len(order)-1.62), fontsize=8.5, color='firebrick',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='firebrick'))
ax.legend(handles=[Line2D([0],[0],color=cols['panther'],lw=6,label='PANTHER PTHR16501 match'),
                   Line2D([0],[0],color=cols['pfam'],lw=6,label='Pfam PF05644 (Mff-like domain) match'),
                   Line2D([0],[0],color='black',lw=6,label='repeat PSSM hit > 10.96 bits')],
          fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
